name: Frost Wipe
description: Ice crystals grow in from the edges of the frame with feathery, branching fronts, frosting the first clip white and blurry until it is covered, then thaw back out to the edges on the second clip. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: spread
params.description: How far the crystal fingers reach ahead of the frost

params.name: scale
params.description: Size of the crystals: more, smaller ones with a larger value

params.name: blur
params.description: How much the frost blurs the picture under it
